title: teller - for those starting out ai trading
author: Several-Proof-6394
selftext:
for those who don't use claude code or want an agent to run 24/7 without their computer, try out teller. 

  
it lives in your imessage so that you can research and trade in one place.   
you can create schedule tasks for it and even run a full auto mode where it places trades for you. 

  
go try it out by texting (949) 847-5913‬ or going to [withteller.com](http://withteller.com)
